La Paz and the Uyuni Salt Flats open a journey linking Bolivia with northern and southern Chile. After the high Altiplano come the Atacama and Santiago, followed by Torres del Paine and water-based routes in the Aysén region.

### Accommodation on the itinerary

| Nights | Location | Hotel and room category | Meals |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1–2 | La Paz | Casa Grande Suites, Presidential Suite | BB |
| 3 | Uyuni | Glamping Uyuni Deluxe or similar, Tent | BB |
| 4–5 | San Pedro de Atacama | Nayara Alto Atacama, Tilo Suite | BB |
| 6–7 | Santiago | Mandarin Oriental, Club Room | BB |
| 8–9 | Puerto Natales | Singular Patagonia, Singular Room King | BB |
| 10–11 | Puerto Río Tranquilo | Mallin Colorado Ecolodge or similar, Cabana Coigüe | BB |
| 12–14 | Santiago | Mandarin Oriental, Club Room | BB |
| 15 | Santiago | Hotel and room category to be confirmed | To be confirmed |

BB: accommodation with breakfast. The full quotation confirms the price, flights, excursions and other services before booking.
